summary: Iter 576 — Full test of Public Self-Signup + Tenant Isolation, CM Quick Setup Wizard, Price Guards (POBA + Surge), and super-admin plan tier 'cm'. Backend: 22/22 pytest PASSED. Frontend: signup e2e worked (landing 'RMS ile Başla' -> /signup -> plan cards visible -> submit -> auto-login -> PendingLegalDocsGate all 6 docs accepted -> CM wizard visible, Go-Live %17 chip, branch selector shows ONLY the newly created hotel (tenant isolation verified in UI), all 8 channel cards + save button present). Price Guards panel opened via sidebar 'Fiyat Bekçileri', POBA + Surge toggles worked, 'Şimdi Çalıştır' produced toast '12 aksiyon uygulandı' + log rows in guards-log. Full DB cleanup performed (rate_overrides poba/surge deleted, price_guard_log cleared for 'default', 5 self_signup test tenants deleted, guards disabled, default plan='full' preserved).

minor.issue: Rate limit is 3 per IP per 10 min but spec/error message says '4th signup within 10 min -> 429'. Code path: recent>=3 rejects, so 3rd signup succeeds and 4th=429. This matches main-agent context note ('3 per IP per 10 min') but conflicts with the review-request phrasing ('4th signup ... -> 429'). Consider clarifying spec/message. Non-blocking.

Response body only contains {tenants,total}; the 'plans' map key is still missing (route conflict noted since iter574/575). Non-fatal for our tests but plan-picker UI reading d.plans may render empty. Persists from previous iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: POSITIVE: cm_onboarding.py is compact (136 lines), all endpoints async, proper 400/422 handling, no _id leaks, mocked test-push clearly labelled ('mocked': True + turkish message).

POSITIVE: price_guards.py cleanly separates worker/API via shared run_price_guards helper; upsert on rate_overrides uses set_by='poba_guard'/'surge_guard' so cleanup is trivial; guardrails clamp (max_rate hi) respected.

POSITIVE: /auth/signup has proper input validation order (plan → hotel/name → email regex → password length → rate-limit → duplicate → provision → login+cookies). Provisions property with correct modules_enabled based on plan and re-applies plan after provisioning (defensive).
POSITIVE: Tenant isolation in GET /properties uses user.property_ids filter for non-admins — verified in test & UI (branch selector shows only 1 hotel).

CONCERN (minor): signup_log doesn't distinguish successful vs failed attempts; a duplicate-email 400 still increments (via the recent read but not the write path, so OK). Verified — 400/422 paths do NOT insert signup_log, good.

CONCERN (minor): PendingLegalDocsGate blocks new users from ALL interaction until 6 docs are accepted; that's 6 clicks per new signup. Fine for humans, painful for QA automation. Consider a bulk-accept dev-only path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (signup, CM wizard visible, Price Guards panel + run + log)
